1|//! zylos-task-durability: Task durability via SQL leases with heartbeat,
2|//! LostLeaseError, maintenance loop, and circuit breaker.
3|//!
4|//! Source: OpenMuse `apps/server/src/engine/worker.ts` (lines 64-76),
5|//! OpenDuet `openbot/server/src/work/queue.ts` (lines 77-81).
6|//!
7|//! # Key Design Decisions
8|//!
9|//! - **Database-as-clock**: All lease timing uses SQL `now() + interval`, NEVER
10|//!   `Utc::now() + Duration` in Rust. This prevents clock-skew bugs where a node
11|//!   90s behind writes a 60s lease that Postgres considers expired on arrival.
12|//! - **SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED**: Each replica takes rows nobody else holds,
13|//!   never waits behind another — zero contention in multi-replica deployments.
14|//! - **LostLeaseError**: Thrown when CAS fails or abort signal fires — reverts task
15|//!   to `queued` atomically. All writes go through `guard()/checkpoint()/event()`
16|//!   which throw on stale lease.
17|//! - **pg_notify inside transaction**: Fires on commit never before; listener on
18|//!   own connection (not pool) because LISTEN holds the connection.

97|        matches!(
98|            (self, target),
99|            (Self::Queued, Self::Running)
100|                | (Self::Queued, Self::Cancelled)
101|                | (Self::Running, Self::Succeeded)
102|                | (Self::Running, Self::Failed)
103|                | (Self::Running, Self::Cancelled)
104|                | (Self::Running, Self::WaitingApproval)
105|                | (Self::Running, Self::WaitingInput)
106|                | (Self::Running, Self::Paused)
107|                | (Self::WaitingApproval, Self::Running)
108|                | (Self::WaitingApproval, Self::Cancelled)
109|                | (Self::WaitingInput, Self::Running)
110|                | (Self::WaitingInput, Self::Cancelled)
111|                | (Self::Scheduled, Self::Queued)
112|                | (Self::Scheduled, Self::Cancelled)
113|                | (Self::Paused, Self::Queued)
114|                | (Self::Paused, Self::Cancelled)

283|pub struct TaskDurabilityEngine {
284|    conn: Arc<Mutex<Connection>>,

291|impl TaskDurabilityEngine {
292|    /// Create a new engine with an existing SQLite connection.
293|    ///
294|    /// Initializes schema if tables don't exist.
295|    pub fn new(conn: Connection, config: TaskDurabilityConfig) -> Result<Self> {
296|        // Initialize schema BEFORE wrapping in async Mutex to avoid blocking_lock in runtime
297|        conn.execute_batch(
298|                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
299|                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
300|                    status INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
301|                    lease_id TEXT,
302|                    lease_until TEXT,
303|                    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
304|                    payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
305|                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
306|                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
307|                );
308|                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_status ON tasks(status);
309|                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_lease_until ON tasks(lease_until);
310|
311|                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runs (
312|                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
313|                    task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
314|                    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
315|                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
316|                    finished_at TEXT
317|                );
318|                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_runs_task_id ON runs(task_id);
319|
320|                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_answers (
321|                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
322|                    task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
323|                    question TEXT NOT NULL,
324|                    answer TEXT NOT NULL,
325|                    answered_at TEXT NOT NULL
326|                );
327|                CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_answers_task_id ON task_answers(task_id);
328|
329|                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS run_events (
330|                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
331|                    run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
332|                    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
333|                    detail TEXT,
334|                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
335|                );",
336|        )?;
337|
338|        let conn = Arc::new(Mutex::new(conn));
339|
340|        Ok(Self {
341|            conn,
342|            config,
343|            metrics: Arc::new(TaskMetrics::default()),
344|            shutdown: Arc::new(Notify::new()),
345|            consecutive_failures: Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)),
346|        })
347|    }

349|    /// Create a new task. Enforces active cap (OpenMuse pattern).
350|    pub async fn create_task(
351|        &self,
352|        id: String,
353|        payload: serde_json::Value,
354|    ) -> Result<()> {
355|        // Check circuit breaker
356|        let failures = self.consecutive_failures.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
357|        if failures >= self.config.circuit_breaker_threshold {
358|            return Err(TaskDurabilityError::CircuitBreakerOpen {
359|                consecutive_failures: failures,
360|            });
361|        }
362|
363|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
364|
365|        // Enforce active cap
366|        let active_count: u32 = conn.query_row(
367|            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)",
368|            [],
369|            |row| row.get(0),
370|        )?;
371|
372|        if active_count >= self.config.active_cap {
373|            return Err(TaskDurabilityError::ActiveCapReached {
374|                cap: self.config.active_cap,
375|            });
376|        }
377|
378|        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
379|        let payload_str = serde_json::to_string(&payload)?;
380|
381|        conn.execute(
382|            "INSERT INTO tasks (id, status, attempts, payload, created_at, updated_at)
383|             VALUES (?1, 0, 1, ?2, ?3, ?3)",
384|            params![id, payload_str, now],
385|        )?;
386|
387|        self.metrics.tasks_created.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
388|        debug!(task_id = %id, "task created");
389|        Ok(())
390|    }

392|    /// Claim a task using SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED pattern.
393|    ///
394|    /// In SQLite we simulate skip-locked via a transaction that checks
395|    /// lease_id IS NULL AND status = queued, then atomically updates.
396|    /// Returns None if no task available.
397|    pub async fn claim_task(&self, owner_id: &str) -> Result<Option<Lease>> {
398|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
399|        let lease_id = Uuid::new_v4();
400|        let lease_id_str = lease_id.to_string();
401|
402|        // Atomic CAS: claim only if status=queued and no active lease
403|        // Using database-as-clock: lease_until = datetime('now', '+N seconds')
404|        let lease_secs = self.config.lease_ms / 1000;
405|        let affected = conn.execute(
406|            "UPDATE tasks SET
407|                status = 1,
408|                lease_id = ?1,
409|                lease_until = datetime('now', '+' || ?2 || ' seconds'),
410|                attempts = attempts + 1,
411|                updated_at = datetime('now')
412|             WHERE id = (
413|                SELECT id FROM tasks
414|                WHERE status = 0 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < datetime('now'))
415|                LIMIT 1
416|             )",
417|            params![lease_id_str, lease_secs],
418|        )?;
419|
420|        if affected == 0 {
421|            return Ok(None);
422|        }
423|
424|        // Fetch the claimed task's ID
425|        let task_id: String = conn.query_row(
426|            "SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE lease_id = ?1",
427|            params![lease_id_str],
428|            |row| row.get(0),
429|        )?;
430|
431|        // Create run record for this lease
432|        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
433|        conn.execute(
434|            "INSERT INTO runs (id, task_id, started_at, status) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, 'running')",
435|            params![lease_id_str, task_id, now],
436|        )?;
437|
438|        self.metrics.leases_acquired.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
439|        // NOTE: consecutive_failures is NOT reset on claim — only on success.
440|        // Resetting on claim would prevent circuit breaker from ever opening
441|        // when tasks fail immediately after claiming.
442|        info!(task_id = %task_id, lease_id = %lease_id, "task claimed");
443|
444|        Ok(Some(Lease {
445|            lease_id,
446|            task_id,
447|            lease_until: Utc::now() + Duration::from_millis(self.config.lease_ms),
448|            owner_id: owner_id.to_string(),
449|        }))
450|    }

452|    /// Renew a lease heartbeat. Returns Err(LostLeaseError) if CAS fails.
453|    ///
454|    /// Must be called every `heartbeat_ms` (= lease_ms / 3).
455|    pub async fn heartbeat(&self, lease: &Lease) -> Result<()> {
456|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
457|        let lease_secs = self.config.lease_ms / 1000;
458|
459|        let affected = conn.execute(
460|            "UPDATE tasks SET
461|                lease_until = datetime('now', '+' || ?1 || ' seconds'),
462|                updated_at = datetime('now')
463|             WHERE id = ?2 AND lease_id = ?3 AND status = 1",
464|            params![lease_secs, lease.task_id, lease.lease_id.to_string()],
465|        )?;
466|
467|        if affected == 0 {
468|            self.metrics.leases_lost.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
469|            return Err(LostLeaseError {
470|                task_id: lease.task_id.clone(),
471|                reason: "heartbeat CAS failed: lease stolen or task state changed".into(),
472|            }
473|            .into());
474|        }
475|
476|        self.metrics.heartbeats_sent.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
477|        debug!(task_id = %lease.task_id, "heartbeat renewed");
478|        Ok(())
479|    }

481|    /// Guard: verify lease is still valid before any write operation.
482|    ///
483|    /// Throws `LostLeaseError` if the lease has been stolen.
484|    pub async fn guard(&self, lease: &Lease) -> Result<()> {
485|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
486|        let valid: bool = conn.query_row(
487|            "SELECT CASE WHEN lease_id = ?1 AND status = 1 AND lease_until > datetime('now')
488|             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
489|             FROM tasks WHERE id = ?2",
490|            params![lease.lease_id.to_string(), lease.task_id],
491|            |row| row.get::<_, i32>(0).map(|v| v != 0),
492|        ).optional()?.unwrap_or(false);
493|
494|        if !valid {
495|            self.metrics.leases_lost.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
496|            return Err(LostLeaseError {
497|                task_id: lease.task_id.clone(),
498|                reason: "guard check failed: lease no longer valid".into(),
499|            }
500|            .into());
501|        }
502|        Ok(())
503|    }

505|    /// Checkpoint: persist intermediate state within a lease.
506|    ///
507|    /// Throws `LostLeaseError` if lease is stale.
508|    pub async fn checkpoint(
509|        &self,
510|        lease: &Lease,
511|        state: &serde_json::Value,
512|    ) -> Result<()> {
513|        self.guard(lease).await?;
514|
515|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
516|        let state_str = serde_json::to_string(state)?;
517|        conn.execute(
518|            "UPDATE tasks SET payload = ?1, updated_at = datetime('now')
519|             WHERE id = ?2 AND lease_id = ?3",
520|            params![state_str, lease.task_id, lease.lease_id.to_string()],
521|        )?;
522|        debug!(task_id = %lease.task_id, "checkpoint saved");
523|        Ok(())
524|    }

540|             VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)",

546|    /// Complete a task successfully. Clears lease.
547|    pub async fn complete_success(&self, lease: &Lease) -> Result<()> {
548|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
549|        let affected = conn.execute(
550|            "UPDATE tasks SET
551|                status = 6,
552|                lease_id = NULL,
553|                lease_until = NULL,
554|                updated_at = datetime('now')
555|             WHERE id = ?1 AND lease_id = ?2 AND status = 1",

561|                task_id: lease.task_id.clone(),
562|                reason: "complete_success CAS failed".into(),

565|        }

568|        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
569|        conn.execute(

571|             WHERE id = ?2",
572|            params![now, lease.lease_id.to_string()],
573|        )?;

580|    /// Fail a task. Reverts to queued for retry or marks failed.
581|    pub async fn complete_failure(
582|        &self,
583|        lease: &Lease,
584|        error_detail: &str,
585|        retryable: bool,
586|    ) -> Result<()> {
587|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
588|        let new_status = if retryable { 0u8 } else { 7u8 }; // Queued or Failed
589|
590|        let affected = conn.execute(
591|            "UPDATE tasks SET
592|                status = ?1,
593|                lease_id = NULL,
594|                lease_until = NULL,
595|                updated_at = datetime('now')
596|             WHERE id = ?2 AND lease_id = ?3 AND status = 1",
597|            params![new_status, lease.task_id, lease.lease_id.to_string()],
598|        )?;
599|
600|        if affected == 0 {
601|            return Err(LostLeaseError {
602|                task_id: lease.task_id.clone(),
603|                reason: "complete_failure CAS failed".into(),
604|            }
605|            .into());
606|        }
607|
608|        // Record failure event
609|        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
610|        conn.execute(
611|            "UPDATE runs SET status = 'failed', finished_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2",
612|            params![now, lease.lease_id.to_string()],
613|        )?;
614|        conn.execute(
615|            "INSERT INTO run_events (run_id, kind, detail, created_at)
616|             VALUES (?1, 'error', ?2, ?3)",
617|            params![lease.lease_id.to_string(), error_detail, now],
618|        )?;
619|
620|        // Track consecutive failures for circuit breaker
621|        let prev = self.consecutive_failures.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
622|        if prev + 1 >= self.config.circuit_breaker_threshold {
623|            self.metrics.circuit_breaker_trips.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
624|            warn!(failures = prev + 1, "circuit breaker opened");
625|        }
626|
627|        info!(task_id = %lease.task_id, retryable, "task failed");
628|        Ok(())
629|    }

672|    /// Control: pause/resume/cancel/retry with CAS precondition.
673|    pub async fn control(
674|        &self,
675|        task_id: &str,
676|        action: ControlAction,
677|    ) -> Result<()> {
678|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
679|        let (current_status, current_lease): (u8, Option<String>) = conn.query_row(
680|            "SELECT status, lease_id FROM tasks WHERE id = ?1",
681|            params![task_id],
682|            |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)),
683|        ).optional()?.ok_or_else(|| TaskDurabilityError::NotFound(task_id.into()))?;
684|
685|        let current = TaskStatus::try_from(current_status)
686|            .map_err(|e| TaskDurabilityError::NotFound(e))?;
687|
688|        let (target, require_no_lease) = match action {
689|            ControlAction::Pause => (TaskStatus::Paused, false),
690|            ControlAction::Resume => (TaskStatus::Queued, true),
691|            ControlAction::Cancel => (TaskStatus::Cancelled, false),
692|            ControlAction::Retry => (TaskStatus::Queued, true),
693|        };
694|
695|        if !current.can_transition_to(target) {
696|            return Err(TaskDurabilityError::InvalidTransition {
697|                task_id: task_id.into(),
698|                from: current,
699|                to: target,
700|            });
701|        }
702|
703|        // Retry rejected if action under review hasn't succeeded
704|        if matches!(action, ControlAction::Retry) && current != TaskStatus::Failed {
705|            return Err(TaskDurabilityError::InvalidTransition {
706|                task_id: task_id.into(),
707|                from: current,
708|                to: TaskStatus::Queued,
709|            });
710|        }
711|
712|        if require_no_lease && current_lease.is_some() {
713|            return Err(TaskDurabilityError::LostLease(LostLeaseError {
714|                task_id: task_id.into(),
715|                reason: "control action requires no active lease".into(),
716|            }));
717|        }
718|
719|        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
720|        conn.execute(
721|            "UPDATE tasks SET status = ?1, lease_id = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ?2
722|             WHERE id = ?3 AND status = ?4",
723|            params![target as u8, now, task_id, current_status],
724|        )?;
725|
726|        info!(task_id, action = ?action, "control action applied");
727|        Ok(())
728|    }

730|    /// Maintenance loop: recover orphaned tasks after crash.
731|    ///
732|    /// Should run every `maintenance_interval_secs`. Recovers tasks whose
733|    /// lease expired without completion (owner crashed).
734|    pub async fn run_maintenance(&self) -> Result<u32> {
735|        let conn = self.conn.lock().await;
736|
737|        // Recover tasks with expired leases still marked as running
738|        let recovered = conn.execute(
739|            "UPDATE tasks SET
740|                status = 0,
741|                lease_id = NULL,
742|                lease_until = NULL,
743|                updated_at = datetime('now')
744|             WHERE status = 1 AND lease_until < datetime('now')",
745|            [],
746|        )?;
747|
748|        if recovered > 0 {
749|            self.metrics
750|                .maintenance_recoveries
751|                .fetch_add(recovered as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
752|            info!(recovered, "maintenance: orphaned tasks recovered");
753|        }
754|
755|        Ok(recovered as u32)
756|    }

758|    /// Compute exponential backoff with jitter for retry scheduling.
759|    pub fn compute_backoff(&self, failure_count: u32) -> Duration {
760|        let max_cap = self.config.max_backoff_minutes * 60;
761|        let base_secs = 2u64.saturating_pow(failure_count.min(30)).saturating_mul(60);
762|        let capped = base_secs.min(max_cap).min(3600);
763|        let jitter_range = capped * self.config.backoff_jitter_pct as u64 / 100;
764|        let jitter = if jitter_range > 0 {
765|            let raw = (std::time::SystemTime::now()
766|                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
767|                .unwrap_or_default()
768|                .subsec_nanos() as u64)
769|                % (jitter_range * 2);
770|            raw as i64 - jitter_range as i64
771|        } else {
772|            0i64
773|        };
774|        let final_secs = ((capped as i64 + jitter).max(60) as u64).min(3600);
775|        Duration::from_secs(final_secs)
776|    }

778|    /// Reset circuit breaker manually.
779|    pub fn reset_circuit_breaker(&self) {
780|        self.consecutive_failures.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
781|        info!("circuit breaker manually reset");
782|    }
